15.content: They are consideration, counsel, insight, thought, mind.

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Chapter of the Two Trees

---

** ¶11:** … the one who opens interior meaning … the per ceptions… the Divine Love … all of them, as He … in the… state of the natural mind … this true perception, the… the wisdom radi ating from this true perception… the sust aining Divine Truth…

---

**¶12:** …the rational kn owled ges that cloth e the external form of the mind … this true perception. They are the scattered wisdoms that lie interm ixed, comp ounded together throughout the whole natural mind.

* [ The " light elements min gled in the totality" corresponds to tru ths from the Divine that have been dispers ed into every region of the natural man , not yet separated and elevated , but present as a lat ent substrate of wisdom within all created thought . ]*

---

**¶14 :** Behold, this is true perception ro oted in good…

---

** ¶15:** …it poss esses five ascending faculties. They are attention , deliber ation, disc ernment, interior thought, and the in most understanding . Its deliberation is the sust aining Divine Truth in its fullness — the Divine Human . Its discernment is the pr imal Divine Wisdom, which dwells within the doctrine of living truth. Its interior thought is the Divine Love proce eding out ward, which dwells within the doctrine of celest ial love, and which sh ines forth in… And the in most understanding is the Divine Itself, dwelling in its own infinite , perfect within the heavenly states of unc reated wisdom.

* [The five fac ulties describe successive interior degrees through which the mind is opened toward the Divine. Each faculty is not merely human but is a dwelling - place — a recept ive form — for a distinct proce eding of the Divine. The " ships " are doctrines: the doctrine of living truth ( water ) receives Divine Wisdom, and the doctrine of celestial love ( fire in its genuine sense ) receives the Divine Love going forth. The "Perfect Man" as the Pillar corresponds exactly to Swedenborg's Divine Human — the Divine Truth that struct urally sustains all derivative wisdom. ]*

---

**¶17 :** It is attention — the lowest and ou termost faculty — that shall first receive what is scattered . And those scattered wisdoms shall be raised up ward into deliber ation; and from deliberation they shall be elevated into discernment, which is the pr imal Divine Wisdom dwelling within the doctrine that gov erns the state of obsc urity in the mind . From discernment they shall rise into interior thought, which is the Divine Love proceeding, dwelling within the doctrine that governs the state of illumin ation. And this great and glorious interior thought shall bring them in ward at last into the inmost understanding, which is the Divine Itself, the God whose essence is truth , the infinite Mind within all the heav enly states of glory .

*[This paragraph describes the process of regener ation as successive elevation . What begins in the ou termost attention of the sens ory mind is lifted degree by degree — through deliber ation ( rational ordering ), through discernment (spiritual sight ), through interior thought (celestial perception ) — until it reaches the in most, where the Divine dw ells. The "ship of the night" corresponds to doctrine that operates during states of spiritual obscurity and tem ptation; the "ship of the day" corresponds to doctrine that operates in states of enlight enment. The entire movement is an infl ux- path : the scattered tru ths within the natural man are gathered and returned to their origin . ]*

---

**¶18 :** This is the true perception ro oted in good, which shall bring forth good works… it is the whole of spiritual life and wisdom forever … it is blessed…

---

**¶19:** …evil … comes to pass in … from… also… the manner in which it stands … the false perception ro oted in evil… of self -love… they are the ruling domin ions of evil… the appearance of heav enly order and the recurring cycles of merely natural life … they are the five corpor eal appet ites that walk about in the external man … evil works… doctrine proce eding from falsity, the hidden principle … which the ruling self-love established in the natural mind.

*[The " five fleshes" correspond to the five sens ory- corpor eal appetites — the inv erted mirror of the five ascending faculties. Where the good tree's lim bs open in ward and up ward toward the Divine, the bad tree's " fl eshes" walk outward and downward into the body . " Heaven and the wheel" in this inf ernal context become the false appearance of spiritual order and the endless repet ition of natural states — what Swedenborg calls the "circle " of merely natural life, which imitates heav enly order but has no interior . The "mystery that Satan appointed " is the hidden persu asion of fals ity from evil that gov erns the unre generate mind from within , uns een . ]*

---

**¶22 :** The false perception rooted in evil also poss esses five fac ulties. They are attention, deliberation , discernment, interior thought, and the inmost understanding — but each is inv erted. Its attention is the law of spiritual death. Its deliberation is the endless passage through successive states of falsity… from one assumed form to another. Its discernment is the consuming tor ment of self-love… the devast ation that is filled with the obsc urity of fals ity. Its interior thought is… a containing form of evil. Its inmost understanding is… the consolidated mass of evil, the final bond age… those things which the ruling self-love cast out … the great… and they fall… into the darkness of total fals ity… all … and they are stripped … and are swallowed into the consolidated mass of evil, and they are bound… the works of darkness, that which they… forever and ever… the face… will arrive at that state ; and there is no turning back within it.

*[Every faculty that in the good tree opened up ward toward the Divine here closes downward into inf ernal states . " The law of death" governing attention means that the ou termost faculty of the evil mind is ruled by spiritual death — it perce ives only what confirms fals ity. "Transmigration in type after type" is not re incarnation in the natural sense; spiritu ally it is the rest less movement of the evil mind through successive assumed forms of falsity, never r esting in any truth . The "furnaces of fire" are the torments that arise from self-love when it can no longer possess what it cr aves. "Smoke " is the dense obscurity of thought that ar ises from the fire of evil love . The "lump" — the consolidated mass — is the final state in which all discrete fals ities and ev ils are f used into a single dead weight from which no individual truth can be extracted. The "last bond" is the final spiritual bondage . There is " no repentance therein" because the will has been so thoroughly confirmed in evil that no freedom to turn remains .]*

---

**¶ 23:** …this is the un folding of the meaning of the false perception rooted in evil, as I have opened it to you… good works … its works evil … within it, during all the states of its existence… within it.

---

**¶24:** …the true perception, being transformed from… which r ests in its good ground , which is the regenerate mind… spiritual life and wisdom ; where spiritual death and fals ity do not exist… And the false perception is the merely corpor eal itself … alone among the… which exists in its evil ground, which is the unregenerate mind… fals ity and spiritual death.

*[The "good earth" and "bad earth" are the regenerate and unregenerate mind respectively . The "good tree in good earth" is true perception rooted in a mind that has been opened to the Divine — where " life and light" ( spiritual life and wisdom) constitute its very substance. The "bad tree" is identified directly with " Matter" — the merely corpor eal and natural , which in Swedenborg's terms is the prop rium, the self hood apart from the Divine. It dw ells in " bad earth" — the mind confirmed in falsity and evil — where only "darkness and death" ( fals ity and spiritual death) exist. ]*

---

**¶25 :** He understands that these two perceptions did not arise out of one another, nor did they proceed from one another. They did not come from a single origin .

* [This is the fundamental principle : good and evil, truth and falsity, are not generated from a common source . Wisdom does not produce falsity, nor does the Divine produce evil. They are rad ically distinct in origin . This corresponds to Swedenborg's ins istence that evil ar ises from the mis use of free will in created beings, not from any quality in the Divine Itself. The two trees share no root . ]*

---

**¶26 :** And he perce ives… evil works did not arise from the true perception… but whoever is unable to distinguish and separate the true from the false within himself falls into the state of total fals ity… until he arrives at the…

*[The final warning : the capacity to discern good from evil, truth from falsity — to " separate " the two trees within one 's own mind — is the essential act of spiritual life. Without this disc ernment, the mind desc ends into darkness . This is what Swedenborg calls va station — the str ipping away of all truth — which continues until the person arrives at whatever final state their inter iors dict ate. ]*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: because [this good] tree, as it grows on this composite earth, [is comparable to the] date palm, because [it is mixed with good and bad], for not absolutely every part of the date palm is used!
[Now] the intellectuals that are cloaked upon its body [are the limbs of] this good tree. They are the light elements that are mingled, being compounded in the totality.
Behold, this is the good tree [that is rooted in the good.]

[Now] it has five limbs. [They are consideration, counsel, insight, thought, mind.] [Its consideration is the Light Mind. Its counsel] is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man. [Its insight is the Fir]st Man who dwells in the ship of living waters. Its thought is the Third Ambassador [who dwells in] the ship of living fire, that shines in [the heavens.] Also, the mind is the Father who dwells in greatness, who is perfect in the aeons of light.

It is consideration that shall [first gather the scattered light; and] they shall be raised up [to that which] is counsel; they shall be raised up to insight, which is the First Man who dwells in the ship of the night; from insight they shall rise up to thought, which is the Ambassador who dwells in the ship of the day. And he too, great glorious thought, shall bring them in to mind; which is the Father, the God of truth, the great Mind of all the aeons of glory.
This is the good tree that shall give good fruit, [for it] is the entire life and light for ever [and ever. All that] occurs [within it for] ever, it is blessed [for ever and ever.]

[Now the] bad [tree: what shall] happen in [the world] from [it?] also [consider] the way that it is [set against] the good tree [: and it has the dominions] of the fire [of desire;] they are the ruling-power [of Darkness, the] heaven and the wheel [of the zodiac;] they are the five fleshes that walk [in the world. Its] fruit [is the te]aching as of error, the mystery that [is hidden, wh]ich Satan appointed in the world.

it being changed from [the mixture. The good tree is the light,] which lies in its good earth [; and it is life] and light; as death and Darkness do not exist [in it.] Also, the bad tree is Matter [and Darkness,] [wh]ich occurs in its bad earth [; and it is] Darkness and death.
